description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirement Your next action this turn is to Cast a Rite.

Deal damage to yourself or a willing ally to massively boost a Rite's effect.

You or one willing ally within 30 feet takes 2d6 damage per your spell rank, which cannot be reduced, prevented, or healed until the end of your next turn. The Rite you cast this turn counts as being heightened by 2 ranks, to a maximum of your highest spell rank. A creature cannot be the source of this damage more than once per 10 minutes.

cinderfall.incomplete: "The Rite cast counts as heightened +2 ranks (max your highest)" is a heightening-override with no confirmed precedent found in pf2e-source within this pass's research budget; the self/ally damage-as-cost clause itself needs no rule element (a stated cost paid in HP needs no encoding, same as any other resource cost described in prose). Flagged as absence-of-evidence on the heightening-override half specifically.
